host: Apple M2 Pro; macOS 27.0 (26A428); en8 10 GbE
cpu_method: Daemon CPU-time delta from 0.5-second ps snapshots inside seconds 2 through the test duration; one core = 100 percent; does not include Windows daemon or iperf.
source_xnu: f6217f891ac0bb64f3d375211650a4c1ff8ca1ea (published source, not claimed identical to the running kernel)
limitations: Sequential experiments, no randomized A/B confidence intervals
Windows daemon revision and CPU not independently verified
No proof of Network.framework internal transport/channel/offload selection
Short-run maximum is not a sustained or absolute platform ceiling

variant_configuration.native-wake: Native kqueue and direct callback signals, kernel probe each iteration; no coalescing.
variant_configuration.active32: native-wake plus one descriptor probe per 32 active iterations.
variant_configuration.qos: active32 plus USER_INITIATED QoS for worker/dispatch threads; no coalescing.
variant_configuration.coalesce: active32 plus batched TCP coalescing (initial experiment before local-address guard).
variant_configuration.shared-completions: coalesce plus reused completion blocks with weak flow references.
variant_configuration.shared-strong: coalesce plus reused strong completion blocks and nonatomic immutable connection properties.
variant_configuration.tcp-options: Same shared-strong binary; iperf socket window and application zero-copy options.
variant_configuration.ipv4-no-checksum: Per-message callbacks restored; requested IPv4 UDP no-checksum. Failed experiment, reverted.
variant_configuration.restored-local-coalesce: active32 plus coalescing restricted to local destination addresses; normal checksums/callbacks.
variant_configuration.owned-send-buffers: restored-local-coalesce plus boxed Rust packet ownership passed to asynchronous dispatch-data destruction.
variant_configuration.receive-window512: restored-local-coalesce with 512 outstanding receives; drain batch remains 128.
variant_configuration.final-release-1: restored-local-coalesce, normal release without io-profile, utun byte buffer unchanged.
variant_configuration.final-release-2: Same release binary, second pass in different mode order.
variant_configuration.paced-release: Same release binary, iperf offered-rate pacing.
variant_configuration.utun4m: Release, 128 batch, 128 outstanding receives, 4 MiB utun SO_RCVBUF, coalescer ambiguous-error prefix hardened.
variant_configuration.batch64-utun4m: utun4m with I/O batch reduced to 64; receive request window still 128.
variant_configuration.selected-repeat: utun4m with 128 batch restored, final build.

validation: Native ring and signal ownership tests under AddressSanitizer
